name: Wavetable Equation Bench
author: Rubato Audio
description: Diagnostic Wavetable engine comparing live equations with Mutable Instruments' 4 KB sampled bank. Not a musical model.

controls.label: Equation
controls.description: Selects one benchmark equation or the sampled-bank baseline.

controls.label: Column
controls.description: Moves across the wavetable bank's eight columns.

controls.label: Row
controls.description: Moves across the wavetable bank's eight rows.

outputs.main: Selected live equation or sampled-bank control
outputs.aux: 5-bit version of MAIN, unless the CPU probe tone is enabled
